newsitem.title: UK: Algeria's Skikda port still closed, forecast poor.
newsitem.headline: Algeria's Skikda port still closed, forecast poor.

text.p: Algeria's Skikda port remained closed on Monday due to high winds and rough waters and the weather forecast was poor for this week, a port official and meteorologists said.
Ten oil tankers were waiting outside the port for loading at Skikda, which has been shut for much of the last two weeks, a port official said.
Naphtha traders said four large cargoes of 50,000 to 60,000 tonnes were waiting to be loaded, three originally to be loaded in the end of November and a fourth for Dec 1-2 loading.
One was expected to end up in the Med, another in Northwest Europe, one in Brazil and the final in the United States, traders said.
"The winds will tend to continue fairly strong over open waters for several days," said Joel Burgio, senior meteorologist at Weather Services Corp in Lexington, Mass.
"I don't see with one storm moving off today and another projected to develop in the Med on Wednesday or Thursday...that there is much opportunity to get those ports open this week," he said.
Winds were averaging between 20 and 30 miles per hour, he said.
